prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a side impact at intersection. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1217; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Left rear quarter panel and rear door show crumpling consistent with a side impact at an intersection, with deformation tracking from the door seam back toward the wheel well. Structural measurements taken on the frame rail confirm the force path described in the claim. Repair plan calls for replacing the rear door shell, straightening the quarter panel, and refinishing adjacent panels for color match. The labor hours submitted line up with the extent of the damage seen. Invoices from the facility show single entries with no duplicated charges. Nothing in our records or the owner's account points to earlier damage on this area of the vehicle.
